quests.title: Go Forth, Golden Whirlwind!

dialogue.t: Might I ask for your name?
Good, I've written it down. May I ask if you are willing to put your honor as a warrior on the line?

dialogue.sit: Oh, no, no, have a nice day.

dialogue.t: Mm? Are you not, then, a warrior who has come forth to take part in this contest?

dialogue.sit: Never heard of such a thing.

dialogue.t: Have you not heard of the "Clash of Lone Blades"?
That can't be, I should have put up notices.
Where did you put them up?
C'mon, that's no use at all! No one's gonna see that, much less come over!

Hmph! This is all the Yashiro Commission's fault, what with their "no weapons or fighting during the Irodori Festival" nonsense. I applied to organize duels on Ritou, but they refused, and wouldn't let me put up advertisements, either.
So I could only put the arena here and place the sign nearby.
That said, we have already had 4 applicants. If we also include you, that makes 5.
Huh, so people actually joined. That's odd. Speaking of which, Paimon can't quite remember why you came here either, {NICKNAME}...
The way I see it, you were able to find this place without any prior hints. This must mean that you are a warrior with a formidable spirit indeed.
Those who hanker after martial prowess will always be attracted to one another. This is the way of the world — and there is little need to be surprised by it.
Paimon has no idea what world you live in.
Hehe. But still, would you be willing to take part?
If you can defeat each of the four challengers, you will receive a reward, as a matter of course.
Well then, please do take your time.

quests.description: You have received no commissions from Katheryne, nor do you have appointments with any friends. And yet, in the darkness, a golden light leads you to a small island in the middle of the ocean. How strange. What in the world happened?
